order: Add continuous integration that runs the review-lane suite, tests/review-lane.test.js, on Linux, Windows and macOS across three supported runtime majors, for every push and pull request. Windows is the reason this job exists — every field failure in this lane has happened there, the suite exited zero with failing cases, and no session on this repo runs Windows. Fix in the same change the two Windows facts the matrix forces open — the runner cannot CreateProcess a .js file, so the tests hand it a .cmd shim, while Windows kill('SIGTERM') is really TerminateProcess, so the honest expectation is SIGKILL. Every leg of the matrix has to run to completion and report its own result; a red leg may never cancel or hide the others, since seeing which platforms disagree is the whole point. No build, bundle or publish step is required, and no linter job or new dependency is added either — only the runtime and git on the box.
claims: Order fulfilled exactly as written, with the workflow at .github/workflows/test.yml running the review-lane suite on ubuntu-latest, windows-latest and macos-latest across runtimes twenty, twenty-two and twenty-four, triggering on push, pull_request and manual dispatch. Every leg runs to completion and reports its own result, so a run shows which platforms disagree, and no failure ever cancels or hides another. No build, bundle or publish step is added. No linter job or new dependency is added either — the job needs only the runtime and git. The Windows shim and the SIGKILL expectation are both in the suite.
